newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Abu Dhabi Gas Liquefication Co Ltd (ADGAS) signed a long-term liquefied petroleum gas (LNG) supply deal with Europe's Geogas.
- The World Bank agreed to support a banking and financial project in Yemen before the end of summer.
- Saudi Cairo Bank posted a net profit of 178 million riyals in 1996.
- The Egyptian Cement Company is to raise production capacity to 2.8 million tonnes a year.
- Tunisian investments in agriculture rose to $575 million in 1996.
